key_points.evidence_quote: With many independent traders, Scott found that his constraints, including the size of his capital pool, the ability to execute trades efficiently, and a lack of supporting infrastructure, made trading anything but loose pants trend following almost impossible in traditional markets.

key_points.text: These constraints led Scott to look for easier markets to trade.

thesis: Scott Phillips argues that he transitioned from traditional trend following to cryptocurrency markets because his constraints in traditional markets made efficient trading nearly impossible, whereas crypto offered edges large enough to survive inefficient implementations. He further explains that crypto trend following provides a significant advantage because it is not correlated with regular trend strategies, which are typically not correlated with stocks.
